title: Reading an optional Colab download helper
description: You can follow the archive path and the recorded environment fallback.

steps.description: You import archive and path helpers, then try to import Colab's files interface. The surrounding try also covers the later archive and download calls.
An existing artifacts path selects archive creation and download. Otherwise the code prints a missing-folder message.

steps.question: Which path handles an unavailable Colab download operation?
steps.answer: The exception handler catches the failure and prints its environment message.

steps.description: You see the helper report that google.colab.files.download is unavailable in code-viz. This supplied run does not report a successful download.
